domainStatus: The domain word is confirmed. The TLD has not been chosen and the domain has not been purchased, so no URL with a TLD may be published yet. This file is the only place the domain is recorded — do not repeat it in a manifest, a skill, a doc or the MCP server output.

offer.note: Prices, tier lists and the rendering policy live in licence.json at the repo root. Read them from there; do not restate them here.

local.note: Compositions render locally with Remotion. There is no per-minute fee and nothing leaves the owner's machine.

hosted.allowanceNote: Motion Master is not on sale, so no hosted rendering is offered and no allowance is published. The recorded terms live in licence.json.
hosted.billingNote: Nothing is ever charged automatically. If you want more than the allowance, you choose it and you pay for it.
hosted.note: Compositions render locally. The MCP server never renders anything itself.
